purpose: Evidence packet only. Each fact is limited to an explicit statement on a directly read official airline page. A combined pet-and-carrier ceiling can exclude a dog that exceeds it alone; it cannot positively clear a smaller dog without the carrier and route conditions.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to pet plus carrier and only to listed Schengen/EU and Svalbard routes; capacity remains limited
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. A dog at or below 8 kg is not positively cleared without carrier weight and route checks.
facts.quote: The container and pet(s) must not exceed 8 kg in total gross weight.
facts.locator: Getting ready to fly → Kennels and crates → In the cabin

facts.condition_scope: officially listed for Schengen/EU flights excluding Ireland and Iceland, plus limited Svalbard and Norwegian connection cases; crate and booking requirements apply
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold may be offered only after route, connection, crate and capacity checks; never present it as a guaranteed booking outcome.
facts.quote: Cats and dogs can travel in the cargo hold on the following flights:

facts.condition_scope: official ceiling applies to the box including the animal; only small cats and dogs and a prior reservation are accepted
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. Under 8 kg dog body weight alone is not a clearance: carrier, route and reservation still apply.
facts.quote: the box including the animal may weigh a maximum of 8 kg.
facts.locator: Pets in Cabin → Transportation in the Cabin

facts.condition_scope: limited number of dogs and cats, carrier and breed information required; reservation only up to 48 hours before departure and only on direct flights
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold can be proposed as conditional, not confirmed: the route must be direct and the airline must accept the requested animal and carrier.
facts.quote: we only allow a limited number of dogs and cats on our aircrafts.
facts.locator: Pets in Cargo Hold → Transporting Pets in Cargo Hold

facts.condition_scope: the published threshold is for the pet as a whole and requires a kennel that fits under the seat; the source does not establish a passenger-hold decision
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. Do not turn the 8 kg statement into a positive clearance without the carrier conditions.
facts.quote: Your furry friend up to 8 kg can travel in the cabin, provided their kennel fits under the seat in front of you.

intentionally_unset.reason: The directly read Eurowings page establishes only the cabin condition. Group membership is not evidence of an Eurowings passenger-hold policy.
No directly read official Eurowings source in this cohort establishes an ordinary pet-dog cargo service.
The directly read Norwegian page documents passenger cargo hold only; it does not establish a separate cargo product for ordinary pet dogs.
The directly read Condor page documents passenger cargo hold only; it does not establish a separate cargo product for ordinary pet dogs.
